subject.title: [Feature]: Include interaction metadata in Discord button callbacks

question: Should generic Discord component clicks expose a documented agent-visible structured interaction metadata envelope, and which fields should be public versus plugin-only?
rationale: The change would create a public inbound-context contract and expose Discord identifiers plus callback data, so maintainers need to choose schema, compatibility shape, and trust boundary before implementation.

options.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
options.body: Expose a bounded metadata envelope with original message id, component kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests and docs.

options.title: Keep Rich Metadata Plugin-Only
options.body: Leave structured fields on registered plugin interactive handlers and document that stateful Discord workflows should use plugin callbacks rather than generic fallback messages.

options.title: Start With Sender And Message
options.body: Expose only clicker and originating message ids first, deferring callback payload semantics until a broader inbound metadata contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a bounded metadata envelope with original message id, component kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` has recent current-main history on the active Discord component type surface where this contract would likely be shaped.
